rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 9 OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED THIRTY HUNDRED AND NINETEEN, AS AMENDED, ENTITLED 'ANTI-GRAFT AND CORRUPT PRACTICES ACT'
rows.abstract: PENALIZES persons who benefit from unlawful acts or omissions of a public officer with imprisonment of six (6) months to five (5) years.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE PRACTICE OF OFFERING, GIVING OR ATTEMPTING TO GIVE OF OFFER, OR ACCEPTING A KICKBACK IN ANY KIND OF COMMERCIAL TRANSACTIONS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Defines "KICKBACK" as money, fee, comission, credit, gift, gratuity, thing of value or compensation of any kind given directly or indirectly by a contractor, employee representative or agent, seller, lessor, lessee, owner or buyer in exchange for favorable treatment in a transaction. Declares the practice punishable by imprisonment from five (5) to 20 years, a fine of P5,000.00 or three (3) times the amount of the value involved.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ENSURE THE SAFETY OF PATRONS OF COMMERCIAL ESTABLISHMENTS, PROVIDING COMPULSORY INSURANCE COVERAGE IN THE EVENT OF DEATH, DISABILITY OR INJURY, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Requires commercial establishments to provide safety signs and billboards showing fire exits. Grants insurance benefits to victims up to P750,000.00.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SECURITY since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT FURTHER AMENDING PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED SEVEN HUNDRED AND SIXTY, AS AMENDED BY CONTINUING THE BAREBOAT CHARTERING PROGRAM AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: EXTENDS the charter or lease contract entered under PD 760 from 1999 to 2006 and transfers the authority to grant certificate of registry from the [Philippine Coast Guard] to Maritime Industry Authority.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR BARANGAY EMPOWERMENT, AMENDING VARIOUS PROVISIONS OF THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Applies to all barangays with a population of 3,000 and grants them tax shares in the quarry  of sand and gravel.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.mother_status: Business for the day on 2000-05-16
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE OFFICE OF THE SPECIAL PROSECUTOR FOR DANGEROUS DRUGS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Aims to prosecute cases involving drug lords and drug traffickers, as well as top government, police and military officials linked to drug operations, appropriating P200 million for the creation of the Office of the Special Prosecutor for DangerousDrugs.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10689

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 25 (d) OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED SIXTEEN HUNDRED THIRTY-EIGHT, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE AFP MILITARY AND SEPARATION DECREE OF 1979, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: States that Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) retirees who have served a fraction of at least six (6) months or more should be counted as a year of service, thus, an AFP retiree with a total length of service of 33 years, 10 months  and 4 days should have a monthly retirement pension computed, based on 34 years of service and not  33 years as presently provided.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATIONAL DEFENSE since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6981, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'WITNESS PROTECTION SECURITY AND BENEFIT ACT', AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Provides for the perpetuation of testimonies of witnesses admitted in the Witness Protection Program in consonance with Rule 134 of the Revised Rules of Court. Entitles witnessess admitted into the program hospitalization benefits while in the safehouse and minor or dependent children free public education, from primary to college.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1998-07-28

rows.manual_status: Approved by the House and transmitted to the Senate on 2000-04-12
rows.author: A040
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2000-04-11, transmitted to on 2000-04-12 and received by the Senate on 2000
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING EMERGENCY LINES, PRESCRIBING THEIR USE, PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: "Emergency Line Safety Act of 1998" Esstablishes emergency lines consisting of six-inch (6")-wide brightly colored plastic line of unlimited length to cordon off an area during police, fire or medical/rescue operations.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08698

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE MODERNIZATION OF FIRE PROTECTION, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Fire Protection Modernization Act of 1998" Considers the acquisition of modern equipment as the main thrust of the Fire Protection Modernization Program. Establishes Fire Protection Service (FPS) in the 1,053 local government units with no existingprotection services; upgrades existing fire protection services; establishes specialized fire protection and related services. Establishes training facilities, including the hiring of internationally accredited training consultants and adviser toward this end.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SECURITY since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING FREE MEDICAL TREATMENT TO SENIOR AND DIFFERENTLY-ABL ED FILIPINO CITIZENS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Grants free hospitalization to Filipino citizens who are sixty (60) years old  or over and differently -abled citizens who are exempt from the payment of income taxes.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING DOMESTIC CARRIERS TO INSURE THEIR PASSENGERS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Passenger Protection Act of 1998". Seeks to alleviate the suffering of injured passengers and help them  to start anew by providing immediate and automatic indemnity to passengers or their heirs. Declares it  a State policy to secure all passengersof domestic commercial airlines, ships and public utility vehicles with automatic and non-contestable insurance policies .
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 484 (a) OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991 (ENVIRONMENTAL & NATURAL RESOURCES OFFICER)
rows.abstract: Mandates the creation of the position of ENVIRONMENTAL AND NATURAL RESOURCES OFFICER in provincial and highly-urbanize d city governments, and optional for municipal governments to ensure the proper integration of environmental concerns in these areas.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CERTAIN SECTIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED FOUR HUNDRED NINETY-THREE, ENTITLED 'AN ACT TO PROHIBIT THE USE OR CONFERRING OF MILITARY OR NAVAL GRADES OR TITLES BY OR UPON PERSONS NOT IN THE SERVICE OF THE ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES OR THE PHILIPPINE CONSTABULARY, TO REGULATE THE WEARING, USE, MANUFACTURE AND SALE OF INSIGNIAS, DECORATIONS AND MEDALS, BADGES, PATCHES AND IDENTIFICATION CARDS PRESCRIBED FOR THE SAID ARMED FORCES OR CONSTABULARY, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES'
rows.abstract: Increased the penalty for illegal conferment of grades and titles in the service of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP)  and the Philippine National Police (PNP). Completely prohibits the possession, wearing use, manufacture and sale of insignias, decorations and medals , badges, patches and identification cards prescribed by the AFP and the PNP.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATIONAL DEFENSE since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 4 (b) OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED NINETY-FIVE, AS AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED EIGHT HUNDRED FIFTY-FIVE AND REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SIXTY-THREE HUNDRED SEVENTY-THREE AND FURTHER AMENDED BY PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED TWELVE HUNDRED SIXTY-FOUR, ENTITLED 'AN ACT TO INCORPORATE THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL RED CROSS'
rows.abstract: EXEMPTS the Philippine National Red Cross from payment of duties, taxes and fees on all importation and purchases for its exclusive use, or for donation to deserving beneficiaries, and rom any withholding tax or any tax on its bank deposits.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SEVENTY-SIX HUNDRED AND FIFTY-NINE, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS 'AN ACT TO IMPOSE THE DEATH PENALTY ON CERTAIN HEINOUS CRIMES', AMENDING FOR THAT PURPOSE THE REVISED PENAL CODE, AS AMENDED, OTHER SPECIAL PENAL LAWS, INCLUDING COMMONWEALTH ACT NUMBERED FOUR HUNDRED AND EIGHT, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS 'THE ARTICLES OF WAR', AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES(RE:PIL FERAGE OF GOVERNMENT EQUIPMENT AND PROPERTIES)
rows.abstract: INCREASES the penalty for PILFERAGE of government equipment and property from [five (5) years ] to a minimum of RECLUSION PERPETUA to DEATH, thus, considering it a heinous crime.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR ANTITRUST PENALTIES
rows.abstract: "Antitrust Act of 1998". Provides penalties for any person who makes any contract or engages in any combination of conspiracy declared to be illegal, or to any person who MONOPOLIZES, conspires with any person to monopolize any part of the trade among several parties or with foreign actions.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR INCENTIVES AND OTHER BENEFITS TO GOVERNMENT TELECOMMUNICAIT ONS WORKERS, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Magna Carta of Government Telecommunicati ons Workers". Provides benefits to the telecommunicati ons personnel in government service to make them at par with their private sector counterpart, thereby helping the government maintain and recruit thebest in the field of telecommunicati ons.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR AN ACCELERATED ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES MODERNIZATION PROGRAM
rows.abstract: "The Accelerated Armed Forces of the Philippines Modernization Program of 1998". Increases the budget ceiling of the AFP Modernization Program from [P50 Billion] to P100 Billion in order to accelerate the upgrading and modernization of the country'sdefense capability.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATIONAL DEFENSE since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL CELLULAR AND WIRELESS TELEPHONE PROGRAM
rows.abstract: "National Cellular and Wireless Telephone Act of 1998". Requires the Department of Transportation and Communications (DOTC) to implement a five -year National Cellular and Wireless Telephone Program using a combination of government and  private investments in an environment of free competition and mandatory interconnection .  Directs that all landline programs of the government be accordingly revised and its appropriations, as well as contracts under negotiations be reprogrammed and redirectedtowards the enforcement of this Act.
rows.status: Approved on Third Reading on 2001-05-30

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING THE CRIME OF STALKING, PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Anti-Stalking Act of 1998". Declares it a policy of the State to ensure the safety of the lives, properties and privacy of its citizens. Seeks to eliminate perpetrator behavior which disrupts normal life for the victim and to prevent such behaviorfrom escalating into violence.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SECURITY since 1998-07-28

rows.manual_status: Approved by the House and transmitted to the Senate on 2000-10-26
rows.author: A040
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2000-10-26, transmitted to on 2000-10-26 and received by the Senate on 2000
rows.title_full: BANK PROTECTION ACT OF 1998
rows.abstract: "Bank Protection Act of 1998". Ensures maximum protection of lives and properties against bank roberries and other bank crimes. Institutes a system where bank employees and other witnesses can effectively help law enforcement authorities in the identification, eventual apprehension and successful prosecution of the bank robbers, criminals and perpetrators.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10746

rows.manual_status: Approved by the House and transmitted to the Senate on 2000-04-12
rows.author: A040
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2000-04-11, transmitted to on 2000-04-12 and received by the Senate on 2000
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION TEN OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED NINE HUNDRED SIXTY-EIGHT, AS AMENDED, ENTITLED 'ESTABLISHING A PROBATION SYSTEM, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES'
rows.abstract: Mandates applicatns for probation to plant trees in critical areas within the locality and render social or community service.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09555

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING POLICE SUPERVISION OVER THE OPERATION OF PRIVATE DETECTIVE, WATCHMAN OR SECURITY GUARD AGENCIES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE 'THE PRIVATE SECURITY AGENCY LAW', AS AMENDE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Safeguards the lives and proeprties of the citizens by strengthening the operation and management of private detective, watchman or security guard agencies. Establishes the Security Guards and Agencies Supervisory Unit (SGASU) to effectively supervise the operations of these agencies.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SECURITY since 1998-07-28

rows.manual_status: Approved by the House and transmitted to the Senate on 2000-05-18
rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SIXTY-FIVE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-NINE, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE "ANTI-CARNAPPIN G ACT OF 1972"(NOTE: PROOF OF OWNERSHIP)
rows.abstract: Amends RA 6539 (The Anti-Carnapping Act of 1972) by requiring owners of motor vehicles and other parts to show only the PROOF OF OWNERSHIP in securing clearance for the purpose of transporting these from one island to another.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2000-05-16, transmitted to on 2000-05-18 and received by the Senate on 2000

second_reading.remarks: Considered the Explanatory Note as the sponsorship remarks.

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7183, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS 'AN ACT REGULATING THE SALE, MANUFACTURE, DISTRIBUTION, AND USE OF FIRECRACKERS AND OTHER PYROTECHNIC DEVICES', AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Specifies that only chemical formulation utilizing potassium perchlorate, sulfur and pyroaluminum, consistent with the international standards and criteria, shall be used in the manufacture of firecrackers and pyrotechnic devices. Prohibites any type of firecracker or pyrotechnic device which contains yellow phosphorous or other highly poisonous chemicals.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SECURITY since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING ANY PRIVATE FIRM WHOSE FORMER OFFICIAL OR EMPLOYEE IS HOLDING A POSITION OF POWER, PRESTIGE, OR INFLUENCE IN THE GOVERNMENT, FROM ENTERING INTO ANY KIND OF BUSINESS RELATION, CONTRACT OR TRANSACTION, WHETHER DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY, WITH THE GOVERNMENT, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Prohibited Transactions Act of 1998". Declares it the policy of the State to INSULATE the business relations, contracts or transactions of the government from any kind of UNDUE PRESSURE or INFLUENCE.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE OVERSEAS WORKERS BANK, PROVIDING INCENTIVES THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Proposes to institutionaliz e support to the Filipino migrant workers through a bank patterned after the GRAMEEN BANK model, with at least 70% of the voting shares of stock owned by OCWs.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE MUSEUM FOR WOMEN AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Establishes the main repository of precious materials and memorabilia of honored women in Philippine history.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING ANY RECLAMATION PROJECT IN MANILA BAY AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR THE VIOLATION THEREOF
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR AUTOMATIC ASSUMPTION OF THE NEXT HIGH RANKING OFFICIAL IN CASES OF TEMPORARY VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF LOCAL CHIEF EXECUTIVE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 46 OF SUBPARAGRAPH (d) OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: Is intedend to ensure the efficient and effective delivery of services to the people, and lessen the "politics" in local governance.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A100
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEVOLVING FIRE PROTECTION SERVICES FROM THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT TO THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS, REPEALING FOR THE PURPOSE CHAPTER IV INCLUDING SECTIONS 53 TO 59 OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED 6975, AND AMENDING PERTINENT PROVISIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED 7160
rows.abstract: Allows the LGUs to have an accountable local government structure by giving them more powers, authority, responsibilitie s and resources.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A100
rows.title_full: AN ACT REORGANIZING THE GUARANTEE FUND FOR SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES (GFSME), RENAMING IT AS THE GFSME CORPORATION, DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Recognizes the important role played by small and medium-sized enterprises in the country's economic development. Provides the same, therefore, with other credit enhancement and supplementation mechanisms to further their growth and viability.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A100
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING TAX EXEMPTION FOR GOODS, COMMODITIES, VEHICLES, EQUIPMENT OR MATERIALS DONATED BY FOREIGN GOVERNMENTS, INSTITUTIONS, PRIVATE ENTITIES OR INDIVIDUALS TO THE GOVERNMENT OF THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES, ITS DEPARTMENTS, BUREAUS, AGENCIES, INSTRUMENTALITI ES AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Aims to remedy the situation where donated goods and materials are rendered scrap and unusable because these are abandoned and neglcted due to the failure of small agencies to pay the customs duties and taxes.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A100
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE BUREAU OF SPECIAL EDUCATION IN THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION, CULTURE AND SPORTS, PROVIDING FOR ITS POWERS, DUTIES AND FUNCTIONS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Proposes to establish a complete and integrated system of special education for learners with special needs in primary, secondary and tertiary school levels.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A100
rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA08756) enacted on 1999-11-23
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE TERMS, CONDITIONS AND LICENSING REQUIREMENT OF REGIONAL OR AREA HEADQUARTERS, REGIONAL OPERATING HEADQUARTERS AND REGIONAL WAREHOUSES OF MULTINATIONAL COMPANIES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF EXECUTIVE ORDERNO. 226, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE OMNIBUS INVESTMENT CODE OF 1987
rows.abstract: Seeks to INCREASE  the incentives being enjoyed by regional oeprating headquarters of multinational companies operating in the country.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07550

rows.author: A100
rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA08759) enacted on 2000-02-14
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZ ING A NATIONAL FACILITATION SERVICE NETWORK THROUGH THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT SERVICE OFFICE IN EVERY PROVINCE, KEY CITIES AND OTHER STRATEGIC AREAS THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY
rows.abstract: "Public Employment Service Office Act of 1998" (PESO). Lays down the groundwork for a facilitated exchange of labor market information between job seekers and employers.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07127

rows.author: A100
rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA08748) enacted on 1999-06-01
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CHAPTER II, SECTION 11, PARAGRAPH THREE (3) OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7916, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE SPECIAL ECONOMIC ZONE ACT OF 1995, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES(RE: SECRETARY OF TRADE AND INDUSTRY AS CHAIRMAN OF THE PEZA)
rows.abstract: Designates the Secretary of Trade and Industry as CHAIRMAN [member] of the Philippine Economic Zone Authority (PEZA).
rows.status: Substituted by HB05992

rows.author: A100
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE ADVERTISING INDUSTRY IN ORDER TO PROTECT CONSUMERS, PROMOTE THE GENERAL WELFARE, AND ENCOURAGE ADVERTISING WHICH UPHOLDS TRUTH AND INCULCATES IN OUR PEOPLE DESIRABLE MORAL VALUES AND CULTURAL TRADITIONS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: PROHIBITS the advertisement of any product, goals or idea which (1) does NOT provide warnings on possible hazardous effects; (2) is deceptive; (3) poses insult to the dignity of our people, particularly women; (4) promotes foreign lifestyle, and (5)is not totally produced in the Philippines.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A100
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE MAXIMUM USE OF PHILIPPINE FLAG VESSELS AND AIR CARRIERS, FURTHER AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED EIGHT HUNDRED AND NINETY-FOUR, AS AMENDED, ENTITLED 'REQUIRING GOVERNMENT OFFICES, AGENCIES, INSTRUMENTALITI ES AND GOVERNMENT-OWNE D OR -CONTROLLED CORPORATIONS, PERSONS AND ENTITIES ENJOYING TAX EXEMPTION, INCENTIVES OR SUBSIDY FROM THE GOVERNMENT TO UTILIZE IN INTERNATIONAL TRANSPORTATION THE SERVICES OF THE PHILIPPINE FLAG AIR CARRIER AND SHIPPING LINES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES OTHER PURPOSES'
rows.abstract: Aims to ensure that all "taxpayer supported" cargo inputs are FIRST OFFERED to Philippine companies.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A100
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A DEPARTMENT OF PSYCHIATRY IN EVERY REGIONAL HOSPITAL AND MEDICAL CENTER OF THE GOVERNMENT, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to DECONGEST the overpopulated mental hospital in Mandaluyong, MM, as well as to attend to the needs of the mentally ill patients in every region at affordable cost.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A100
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROMOTE THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE DOMESTIC SHIPPING INDUSTRY
rows.abstract: Provides for the development of the domestic shipping industry by granting TAX INCENTIVES to ship owners and operators engaged in inter-island trade.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS since 1998-07-28

rows.author: A100
rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA08799) enacted on 2000-07-19
rows.title_full: THE SECURITIES REGULATION AND ENFORCEMENT ACT
rows.abstract: Answers the need for a new legal and regulatory framework of the capital market, one that is more updated, growth-oriented and flexible to ensure investor protection.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08015

rows.author: A094
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE PHILIPPINE COCONUT AUTHORITY, REAFFIRMING THE COCONUT LEVIES AS PUBLIC FUNDS, INCREASING THE SMALL COCONUT FARMERS' PARTICIPATION IN, AND THEIR BENEFITS FROM, THE COCONUT INDUSTRY, AND BOLSTERING THE INDUSTRY'S DEVELOPMENT,AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED FOURTEEN HUNDRED AND SIXTY-EIGHT, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE REVISED COCONUT INDUSTRY CODE
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 1998-07-28

rows.manual_status: Approved by the House and transmitted to the Senate on 2000-02-03
rows.author: A094
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2000-02-02, transmitted to on 2000-02-03 and received by the Senate on 2000
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR AN EXPANDED REPRESENTATION OF SMALL GRAINS FARMERS IN THE NATIONAL FOOD AUTHORITY COUNCIL AND AN INCREASE IN THE PER DIEMS OF COUNCIL MEMBERS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 6 OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED SEVENTEEN HUNDREDAND SEVENTY, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Envisions the formulation of more effective policies and programs to ensure the sustained well-being of our grains farmers.
rows.status: Substituted by HB06314

rows.manual_status: Approved by the House and transmitted to the Senate on 2001-02-06
rows.author: A094
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2001-02-05, transmitted to on 2001-02-06 and received by the Senate on 2001
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING COOPERATIVES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SIXTY-NINE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-EIGHT, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'COOPERATIVE CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES'
rows.abstract: Puts stress on the promotion of social justice and allows the lower income groups to increase their ownership in the country's wealth by granting meaningful assistance to cooperatives of the lower-income groups.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10614
